notice: Aggregation thresholds and wording bins of the continuous engine (docs/ENGINE_REDESIGN.md, docs/MOTIF_SCORING.md). Design parameters, not calibrated perceptual thresholds.
fetch_policy: Every default domain is fetched (budget and access permitting): under graded scoring any related domain can change a motif score, so no domain is provably irrelevant.

aggregation.value: sum(w * v) / sum(w) over motifs with a non-null cell on the axis, w = motif score * confidence weight of the cell
aggregation.mass: sum(w * |v|): the directional evidence behind the axis
aggregation.agreement: |sum(w * v)| / mass; 1 = all contributors point the same way, 0 = they cancel

states.open: mass below min_mass: not enough directional evidence on this axis (one weak, low-confidence cell needs a motif score of at least 0.5 to show a tentative leaning)
states.balanced_open: enough mass but agreement below min_agreement (one side does not outweigh the other two to one): left open, never averaged into a confident middle
states.resolved: enough mass and agreement; the value is described in words

aggregation.common_only: motifs supported only by common cues (lexicon-0.3 commonness) never contribute; they are listed as context

lead.why: a motif leads the result only when its score reaches this level; below it, it is shown as a minor signal

changes.reason: Phase 5 of the engine refactor: first parameters of the continuous sensory engine.

wording_note: 'balanced' is used only for evidenced neutrality (contributing cells of value 0); a weak tendency keeps its pole ('slightly cool').
confidence_word_cap_why: The confidence word measures how much Qloo evidence stands behind the motifs; it is capped by the best confidence of the motif-to-dimension cells involved, so a dimension that rests only on low-confidence cells (MOTIF design opinion) always reads 'tentative'.
